title: iliamna rivularis var. cismontana
intro: Iliamna rivularis var. cismontana, commonly known as Mountain Globe Mallow, is a flowering plant that belongs to the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing skin irritations, and providing antioxidant effects, making it beneficial for treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Globe Mallow are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which can aid in wound healing and skin protection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
